conf.description: VTC Systems, device-admin-auth, syslog-kv: parses the same Expressway/VCS tvcs event log (admin-session, authorization, config-change, registration branch) into ECS. source.ip merges the admin-session 'ipaddr' and registration 'Src-ip' elements; event.outcome derives from the Accepted/Rejected/Failure/Removed sense of Event.

conf.comment: Expressway/VCS admin/registration branch of the same tvcs event log as call-signaling; split from it by Event value. Hyphenated vendor names (Src-ip, Src-alias, Response-code) are read via bracket-notation in eval and removed with code, since rename/eval.remove reject hyphenated property paths on this platform. System Configuration Changed's Detail payload (setting name + new value) is NOT split here - no documented delimiter for that text exists in the work order, so it stays a single message string; declared gap.

functions.description: Message body: a Cribl Syslog Source leaves the full line, header included, in _raw and the body in message; anything else carries the body in _raw.
Extract the tvcs name=value pairs from _raw
Derive ECS/custom fields (bracket-read hyphenated vendor names); remove plain-identifier originals
Remove hyphenated vendor originals - rename/eval.remove reject hyphenated property paths
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
